headline: Orca 把已有的 Claude Code 与 Codex 订阅编成可远程调度的机器人队，Skills 与跨会话记忆同步升温。
headlineEn: Orca turns existing Claude Code and Codex subscriptions into a dispatchable bot fleet, as skills repos and session memory climb with it.

lead.name: stablyai/orca
lead.zh: 开源客户端，用你自己的 Claude Code 或 Codex 在桌面、手机和远程环境跑机器人，并可从 Slack 交任务。
lead.en: An open-source client that runs bots on your own Claude Code or Codex, on desktop, phone, or a remote machine, and takes jobs from Slack.
lead.why: 每天在用编程代理的人已经买过模型额度。Orca 不另开一套订阅，而是把 Claude Code 或 Codex 接到 Slack、手机和远程机器，任务结束可回同一标签页审查。
lead.whyEn: Built for people who already run coding agents: it does not sell another model plan, it wires the subscription you have into a fleet you can dispatch from Slack or a phone and review in one tab.

sections.title: 用自有订阅编排 Agent 队伍
sections.titleEn: Agent crews on the subscriptions you already pay for

items.name: paperclipai/paperclip
items.zh: 开源工作台，把多个 Agent 的目标、权限、任务和费用收进同一块看板。
items.en: Open-source orchestration that keeps goals, permissions, tasks, and spend for a group of agents on a single board.

items.name: msitarzewski/agency-agents
items.zh: 一组带角色与交付物的专家 Agent，可用桌面应用装进 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex。
items.en: Specialist agents with defined roles and deliverables, installable into Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex from a desktop app.

items.name: MyClaw 3.0
items.zh: 产品页称可组建全天候在线、并共享记忆的 AI 团队。
items.en: Listed as a way to stand up a round-the-clock AI crew that keeps shared memory.

items.name: OpenEight
items.zh: 官方介绍把它写成 AI Agent 的确定性控制层。
items.en: Listed as a control layer meant to make AI agents behave deterministically.

sections.title: Skills 仓库与工程指挥栈
sections.titleEn: Skills repositories and a command stack for engineering

items.name: mattpocock/skills
items.zh: 作者从日常 .agents 目录抽出可组合的小技能，强调自己掌控工程流程。
items.en: Composable skills pulled from a working .agents folder, written so engineers keep control of the process.

items.name: anthropics/skills
items.zh: 仓库提供给 Claude 加载的技能文件夹，内含说明、脚本和资源，用来重复专项任务。
items.en: Public folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads when a specialized task needs a repeatable method.

items.name: garrytan/gstack
items.zh: YC 总裁公开的 Claude Code 配置，用二十三个斜杠命令角色覆盖产品到发布。
items.en: The Claude Code setup Garry Tan uses, expressed as twenty-three slash-command roles from product thinking through release.

sections.title: 跨会话记忆与桌面伴侣

items.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.zh: 跨会话保存代理做过的事，压缩后再注入后续对话，支持 Claude Code 与 Codex 等。
items.en: Records what an agent does, compresses it, and feeds the useful bits into later sessions across Claude Code, Codex, and other agents.

items.name: WhiteBr1ck/agy-powertools
items.zh: 挂在 Antigravity 2.0 内做界面汉化、上下文与缓存监控、会话分支和本地用量面板。
items.en: A native overlay for Antigravity 2.0: Chinese UI, context and cache meters, session branches, and a local usage panel.

items.name: qianyiai/kurocat
items.zh: 开源桌面打字猫，README 称可与 Claude Code、Codex 等编程代理实时联动。
items.en: An open-source desktop typing cat; the README says it can live-link with Claude Code, Codex, and similar coding agents.

items.name: VibeCode.surf
items.zh: 产品页称这是让 Agent 构建、运行并测试应用的 AI 代码编辑器。
items.en: Listed as a code editor in which agents assemble, run, and test the application.
